{{Quote|Get to your positions. And ''remember'', Lord Vader wants ''prisoners''. No disintegrations, unless you're looking for early ''retirement''.|A [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]|<ref name="Drone Alone">{{SWComicCite|7.10|Drone Alone}}</ref>}}
A '''disintegrator''' or '''disintegrator ray''' was an energy beam that destroyed an object by disintegrating it to its basic components, which usually dispersed into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].

[[City/Legends|City]] services used disintegrators to destroy trash collected by [[Janitor/Legends|sanitation workers]] in [[repulsorcart dumpster]]s.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
